items.name: gai
items.description: A lightweight AI agent and skill workflow framework built with Godot.

items.name: emisar
items.description: Let AI agents investigate and operate infrastructure through declared actions, bounded by policy and host-side checks. Approvals when required, with an audit trail. By Protectorate.

items.name: three.ws
items.description: Give your AI agent a 3D body: text or a photo to a rigged GLB avatar, an LLM brain, a Solana wallet and a one-tag embed. Keyless MCP server for Claude, Cursor and Codex. 50k+ models forged.

items.name: wmux
items.description: The ADE for AI agents. Automate everything else. Do your true work.

items.name: retail-shopping-assistant
items.description: The Retail Shopping Assistant is an AI-powered blueprint that provides a comprehensive interface for an intelligent retail shopping advisor. Built with LangGraph for agent orchestration, it features multi-agent architecture, real-time streaming responses, image-based search, and intelligent shopping cart management.

items.name: Orkas
items.description: Orkas is an open-source (MIT), local-first AI team for your desktop: a Commander turns your goal into to-dos and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes, with projects, scheduled automations and connectors. Free app for macOS & Windows; built-in models or your own keys.

items.name: Claude-of-Tanks
items.description: A World of Tanks-style armored combat simulator built directly with Three.js and Vite: 220 vehicles, 33 destructible battlefields, and 13 modes, with plate-level armor, ballistics, modules, spotting, and physics. Play in your browser on desktop or mobile. Built end-to-end by a multi-agent Claude/Codex pipeline.

items.name: VenusFactory2
items.description: 🏭 AI agent platform with skills for protein engineering, the noob-friendly AI tutorial tool for life science professionals. (ACL Demo2025, arXiv 2026)

items.name: airbyte
items.description: Open-source data movement for ELT pipelines and AI agents — from APIs, databases & files to warehouses, lakes, and AI applications. Both self-hosted and Cloud.

items.name: ekko-studio
items.description: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available on desktop and the web.
